not_supported: One reconstruction component is the unique cause.
The nested 2x refinement is formal convergence against an independently generated high-resolution physical input.
The controlled gap changes are additive causal shares; interactions remain possible.
supported: Sponge, boundary, domain extent, and nested spatial refinement are changed in explicit controlled contrasts.
The 96x96 and extended 192x192 domains share the same cell size and an exactly nested central 96x96 initial state.
The extended/open/no-sponge residual matches GeoClaw's domain, input, cell size, requested times, and broad open boundary class, leaving a combined numerical-method residual.

variants.interpretation: Removes only the elapsed-time cosine sponge.

variants.interpretation: Changes only radiation to zero-gradient open faces.
variants.label: Production 96, open, no sponge

variants.interpretation: Moves the open boundary outward using the exact frozen GeoClaw-domain input; cell size and shared central 96x96 state remain unchanged.
variants.label: Extended 192, open, no sponge

variants.interpretation: Halves dx on the same physical domain using nested piecewise-constant cell averages, then area-restricts the 128x128 publication crop to 64x64. This is a discretization sensitivity, not a new high-resolution physical input.
variants.label: 2x refined production domain, open, no sponge
